World design

Thornweald

The Wardens investigate hollow resonators that attract predators; the player chooses a recorded diplomatic response, not an irreversible main-story lock.

Climate, lighting and weather

Ancient closed-canopy woodland; dappled light, cool dusk and periodic rain. Maintain readable sprite outlines under canopy.

Factions

River Compact; Cairn Wardens

Settlement and service placement

Boughrest trail camp supplies a merchant, healer contact and return shrine. Wardens occupy a ruined boundary tower; no full bank until a later content milestone.

Travel-time tests

Proposed 4–6 minutes between trail camp and boundary tower, with shortcuts unlocked through exploration rather than mandatory vertical climbing.

Environmental hazards

Roots and narrow bridges test stairs/steps and camera occlusion. Hollow trees are interiors, not fully simulated tree destruction.

Quest arc and consequences

The Wardens investigate hollow resonators that attract predators; the player chooses a recorded diplomatic response, not an irreversible main-story lock.

Landmarks and discovery

Hollow Choir; Boundary Tower; Sevenroot Bridge

Enemy families

Barkhide boars (8–12); Thorn moth swarms (12–16); Hollow wardens (16–20)

Ore distribution

CopperOre: old trail cuts; DeepIron: rare exposed ravines

Tree distribution

OakLog: common clearings; DarkBough: uncommon fallen stands

Fish species pools

ShadePerch: stream bends; RootEel: cave-fed pools

Music and ambience

Sparse bowed strings and branch creaks; distinguish hostile cues from ambient animal calls visually as well as acoustically.

3D art production requirements

Canopy/occluder materials, layered ground cover, bridge meshes, tower kit and three creature sprite families. Phase06 uses only a safe gate courtyard and legal debug placeholders.

Optimization and streaming

Canopy/foliage culling and simple collision; navigation on authored trails; test relevancy across tree occlusion independently of rendering.

Gate authoring

Author dry clear arrival spawns outside trigger bounds. Validate compatible build/capacity/eligibility before issuing a ticket. Gate labels are not stable identity; use the listed IDs. The reciprocal pair is checked by the documentation validator.

Concrete production and test steps

  1. Create the map/definition according to the asset pages; only activate the first-phase portion now.
  2. Graybox services/roads/water with legal primitives and validate capsule/navigation before art replacement.
  3. Register stable site/gate/encounter/NPC/objective IDs through the existing schemas.
  4. Assign current-phase references in zone runtime and run two-client admission/travel tests.
  5. Reciprocal Rillmere gate works with source player left behind.
  6. Tall canopy fades locally without removing server collision.
  7. Navmesh routes enemies across Sevenroot Bridge and leashes safely.
  8. Missing creature animation uses debug presentation without changing hit capsule.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
